item.title: Ghosts - The Life and Times of Esther Greene - Review
item.description: It's sometimes easy to forget just how many diverse and remarkable bit characters exist in the "Ghosts" universe. Any given episode can feature emissaries of the Devil, Latvian ghost hunters, Vikings with daddy issues, or even financially challenged restaurant employees. Most of these characters do not live at Woodstone, but they always seem to find a reason to make a miraculous reappearance there. item.description: Thank you for submitting your nominations! You now get to narrow the list of 10 down to just one winner and see who will be crowned SpoilerTV's Performer of the Month. The winner will secure a spot in the year-end Performer of the Year. Pick only one! Happy Voting! Voting will close at 9:00AM Friday 26th of December 2025.
